## 5. Checklist (basic quality checks)

- [ ] Code compiles and tests pass locally
- [ ] I removed temporary logs, debug statements, and commented-out code
- [ ] I updated documentation or code comments if behavior changed
- [ ] I kept functions and files small and readable
- [ ] I named variables and functions clearly
- [ ] No secrets or credentials were added to the code
- [ ] Database migrations were reviewed (if any)
- [ ] Environment variables are documented (if new ones were added)
